posts.text: Attorney General Todd Blanche’s DOJ issued an advisory memo that broadens how executive privilege should be applied. Under the new interpretation, Trump could invoke executive privilege and refuse to share with courts and Congress communications with private advisors, who don’t work for the federal government. This would make accountability and scrutiny of executive actions more difficult.
